_meta.name: Bodytwin claims-graph excerpt (public example)
_meta.note: A filtered excerpt of a physiology claims graph: one node per claim, with the certification design summarised by its status and its evidence-artifact count. Node text was reduced to the scientific claim; internal annotations, file paths and identifiers were removed. Nodes concerning any individual were removed in full.

vocabulary.leg: one independent measurement route for a claim
vocabulary.anchor: a held-out external reference the legs must agree with
vocabulary.cell: one claim node together with the small model/script that tests it
vocabulary.n_eff: effective number of independent legs after shared-input collapse
vocabulary.load: number of nodes in this excerpt that depend on the node

nodes.claim: Per-muscle fiber-type (I/IIa/IIx) + satellite reserve via transcript/proteome/EM legs vs histological imaging anchor; satellite sub-axis HYPOTHESIS-only (no functional anchor)
nodes.regime_note: adult human skeletal; satellite/regeneration needs a load/disuse intervention, not a resting atlas.

nodes.claim: DEFECT: OpenSim .osim `range` = a-priori solver clamps NOT measurements (verified radians, Gait2392 hip -120/120 & ankle -90/90 non-physiological, 60% diff across authors) -> 3/4 legs collapse to n_eff=1 (OpenSim family); AddBiomechanics gait anchor never reaches ROM limits […]
nodes.regime_note: normal joints only; pathology is MSK-ORTHOPEDIC.

nodes.claim: Tendon-tension/cartilage load-bearing (occluded 'tendon under tension vs slack') via mechanobiology/ECM-proteomics/tensile/ultrasound legs vs cadaveric knee-FE ligament-force model […]
nodes.regime_note: omics legs NOT same-sample-paired with mechanical/imaging legs (thin axis, arch note 6).

nodes.claim: Same hiPSC-BBB-chip TEER(electrical) vs Papp(mass-transport) move oppositely under disruption; directional sign checked vs held-out gut barrier (FD4 + IBD).
nodes.regime_note: TEER is aggregate paracellular, NOT ion-species-resolved; true per-ion Nernst (patch-clamp) not in archive.

nodes.claim: HONEST_LIMIT: n=4 UNDERPOWERED (hFB14 only 2 points) -- this is 'not detected at n=4', not a definitive absence. A powered test needs more paired-lineage (Seahorse+DNAm+passage) fibroblast donors = FENCED-acquire.
nodes.regime_note: sun-picard N-discrepancy unresolved (verify GSE179848); DNAm-age magnitude does NOT transfer cross-tissue, only qualitative. Cycling(passage) vs calendar(chronological) analog (P16) — don't conflate.

nodes.claim: Localize deafness stage via hair-cell structural+genetic vs ABR-latency-pattern + human audiometry; CENTRAL stage UNANCHORED (no corpus)
nodes.regime_note: sensor-vs-relay machine-checkable via ABR peak-I; central (cortical deafness) 2/3 anchored only.

nodes.claim: BLOCKER: atlas-r2-stroke per-subject masks are access-gated (Google-Form ToU + emailed password) -- NOT open (brief misclassified); used open NeuroVault aggregate (cohort-level, not per-subject). Structural-lesion leg deferred like nscisc. OCCLUDED_TRUTH_DEMONSTRATED: central motor signal SURVIVES despite relay (SCI) failure -- proven via the movement-DECODE consequence, not appearance.
nodes.regime_note: PRO-ACT ALS = negative control (LMN/effector failure, both central+relay intact) — must not misclassify.

nodes.claim: Enteric NS + intrinsic cardiac NS show local sensory-inter-motor complement for edge-compute in 2 organ-distinct systems vs DRG relay-only negative control; SPARC vagus VNS→cardiac-effect as functional anchor […]
nodes.regime_note: certifies STRUCTURAL precondition (cell-type complement), NOT measured autonomous firing (no isolated-ganglion ephys).

nodes.claim: FORCED HONEST-NEGATIVE: olfaction has 1 uncrossed leg, no 2nd leg, no anchor; taste has ZERO data.
nodes.regime_note: single uncrossed leg; taste is the cluster's clearest zero-coverage gap.

nodes.claim: Certify cardiac autonomic control (SAN pacemaker firing + vagal/sympathetic modulation) via its measurable population-level consequence: heart-rate variability […]
nodes.regime_note: Fully open end-to-end (no controlled-access dataset in this cell). Leg (a) pools two snRNA sources (pacemaker + ganglion) -- COMMON-MODE on assay; leg (b) SPARC vagus stimulation-response is the true orthogonal force.

nodes.claim: FIX: hidden_state -> whole-kidney AGGREGATE (matches bulk perfusate anchor granularity); per-segment demoted to hypothesis; graft_function_genomics leg (BOTH gse21374 AND phs001667 = transplant-context mismatch) replaced WHOLESALE with ckdgen-egfr-gwas-stanzick2021 (baseline filtration-function GWAS, decorrelated from KPMP atlas)
nodes.regime_note: Anchor (mw-st002785) is the rare TRUE functional measurement (ex vivo normothermic perfusion of an intact kidney) in this cluster -- CC BY 4.0, open. No in-vivo GFR/clearance dataset located (honest gap).

nodes.claim: FIX: replace MOUSE gse84498 zonation leg with HUMAN gse124395 (Aizarani 2019) -> species mismatch RESOLVED (markers conserved, verified full-text); anchor mtbls10481 confirmed whole-tissue BULK (ISA-tab, 0 zone factors) -> zone-specific claim DOWNGRADED to whole-liver-bulk consistency […]
nodes.regime_note: Cleanest certification in the cluster: all three sources open/CC-BY, legs genuinely orthogonal assay technology (RNA-seq vs mechanical imaging), anchor is a real flux MEASUREMENT not an inference. Supplementary leg geo-gse93382-gh-pulse (hormone-driven liver transcriptome dynamics) available but shares leg (a)'s RNA-seq modality -- not counted as a 3rd independent leg.

nodes.claim: HONEST_LIMIT: DISJOINT COHORTS (taxonomy mode 10, same as KNEE): enzyme-capacity legs (GSE84133/GSE125970 donors) and the cgmacros anchor (its own 45 subjects) share NO subjects -> the enzyme->glycemic-response certification can only be POPULATION/design-level, NOT individual over-determination.
nodes.regime_note: BRENDA/SABIO kinetics are CONSTRUCTED/aggregated in-vitro purified-enzyme measurements, not raw single-experiment data -- used only as supporting mechanism evidence, NEVER as the anchor (measured-vs-constructed discipline). cgmacros is genuinely measured, open, CC-BY-NC-SA.

nodes.claim: Certify skin structural aging + lesion phenotype against a real measured wound-healing process trajectory.
nodes.regime_note: No transdermal-permeability functional assay (TEER-analog) located for skin specifically (unlike BBB's zenodo-bbb-chip) -- anchor is a PROCESS outcome (healing trajectory), not a barrier-integrity instrument (honest gap). Wound-roadmap access is mixed (GEO open / EGA companion controlled).

nodes.claim: LITERAL_TEST_FAILS_CORRECTLY: raw MAE<0.5*null FAILS (ratio 0.956, p=0.278) -- dominated by a ~20-27y tissue OFFSET (fibroblasts score younger on the blood-trained Hannum clock; source paper says Skin&Blood clock is best-calibrated here). The offset is orthogonal to RANK. ADVERSARY_FORCED: two offset-IMMUNE checks both show the signal is real: (1) Spearman rho=0.83 exact-perm p=0.004 (all 362880 orderings), jackknife-robust; (2) LOO single-global-offset-calibrated MAE=5.76y (non-circular) beats 0.5x null (0.25x)
nodes.regime_note: genuine cross-tissue domain-shift test; Sun-Picard rare open exception (load-bearing).

nodes.claim: ReproGen genetic timing score (spans menarche+menopause) predicts held-out bone-age pubertal timing AND SWAN menopausal timing vs clinical event (Tanner/FMP).
nodes.regime_note: puberty & menopause are DIFFERENT cohorts — genetics legitimately spans both, not same-sample.

nodes.claim: ROOT_CAUSE: CS7 is a SINGLETON (1 specimen, Tyser) perfectly CONFOUNDED with assay technology (Tyser SMART-seq2 vs Xu 10x). In LOSO, CS7 is structurally absent from training when Tyser is held out (recall ~0/500) -> the apparent accuracy is WITHIN-Xu discrimination (same technology), not cross-atlas/cross-technology Carnegie recovery.
nodes.regime_note: Carnegie predates scRNA → decorrelated though same-specimen; no blind-unstaged validation exists.

nodes.claim: SOD1-perturbation expression signatures CONVERGE on shared pathways across mouse+human (gate on MIN per-leg significance, not mean), vs ClinVar SOD1 pathogenicity anchor. HONEST ASYMMETRY: no canine SOD1/DM transcriptome in archive -> dog leg is GENOTYPE/GWAS-only (weaker). Must BEAT a matched non-same-gene neurodegeneration trio (adversary) or the 'conserved mechanism' claim = generic dying-neuron artifact.

Three non-overlapping measurement chains converge: (1) human lesion-to-behavior dissociation (purely neuropsychological, no electrophysiology) establishes hippocampal NECESSITY for new episodic memory; (2) rodent place/grid-cell electrophysiology (direct spike-to-position readout, no lesion) establishes WHAT is computed (a spatial/relational code); (3) closed-loop SWR causal-disruption (interventional, stimulation-to-behavior) establishes the REPLAY MECHANISM linking (1) and (2) over time.

three independent instrument/observable classes converge on the same funnel/Anfinsen mechanism: equilibrium calorimetry (DSC: DeltaH,Tm,DeltaCp; 2 independent proteins/datasets) vs kinetic T-jump/laser measurements (tau_fold; 4 independent proteins spanning N=35-100) vs structural/topological statistics (Plaxco contact-order regression, a native-contact-graph quantity) -- none of these three shares a measurement apparatus or a fitted parameter with either of the other two […]

Two fully independent lines converge without sharing a random-code Monte Carlo: (1) deterministic wobble-redundancy count (68.9% synonymous at position 3, structural fact about the fixed codon table alone, zero randomness involved) and (2) deterministic eta^2 clustering-by-2nd-position-nucleotide (0.578-0.756 variance explained, again zero randomness), both independently pointing the same direction as the Monte-Carlo rank-vs-random-code test.

A reduced 15-species compartmental cascade model, previously certified only against a decorrelated clinical anchor, is now cross-checked against the FULL primary-source-cited 34-species/42-rate-constant system (parsed directly from the primary-source-curated model file, zero tuning): the full system (a) reproduces the same wide external anchor band on the extrinsic/initiation-only leg but with WORSE point-accuracy than the tuned reduced model on 3 of 4 headline metrics, (b) does NOT reconcile with the reduced model's reported numbers at any single operating point (implied-equivalent trigger-level spread ~4.2x across metrics; one metric unreachable anywhere in the swept physiological range), and (c) structurally CANNOT be used to test the reduced model's second-arm (contact-pathway-analog) falsifiers at all, because the cited full system contains zero contact-pathway species -- that leg's passing result rests entirely on the reduced model's own bolt-on mechanism, not on anything independently verifiable in the full system […]
nodes.regime_note: Full-system leg (extrinsic/initiation-only) is anchored against a real independent clinical cohort (n=120) at the literature-standard low trigger concentration; the second-arm leg is regime-untestable (missing species in the cited primary source), not merely under-anchored.
